definitions.explanation: Rain that falls heavily or in large amounts.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The train stopped due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A heavy rain warning has been issued.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。

notes:
{大雨|おおあめ} means heavy rain — significantly heavier than normal rainfall.

FORMS:
⟦{大|おお}→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (big, heavy) + ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大雨|おおあめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: heavy rain falls
- {大雨|おおあめ}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: heavy rain warning
- {大雨|おおあめ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: heavy rain advisory (less severe)
- {大雨|おおあめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧: canceled due to heavy rain
- {大雨|おおあめ}⟦による→による：noentry⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage caused by heavy rain

INTENSITY SCALE:
- ⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧: light rain
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: rain (normal)
- {大雨|おおあめ}: heavy rain
- ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧: torrential rain (more intense, often implies disaster-level)
- ⟦{集中豪雨|しゅうちゅうごうう}→集中豪雨：23883_shuuchuugouu⟧: localized torrential rain
